name: com.origuma.easytoon-urp
description: Toon character shader for URP built for 3D live stages. The Idol shader keeps the BRDF physical (GGX, Charlie sheen, Kajiya-Kay / anisotropic GGX hair, clearcoat, iridescence, glitter) and stylizes only the diffuse transfer, so the character sits inside PBR lighting: baked 16-bit face SDF shadows, curvature-driven soft terminator, HQ self shadow (PCSS), hair see-through, rim / Peach Fuzz, fill light, light conditioning against stage lighting, black-out, dissolve, outline, and motion vectors for TAA. Maps are baked in-editor (no DCC needed) via EasyShaderCore.
